answer: A concrete sybil defense is a verifiable delay function guarding every live seat. A VDF requires thousands of strictly sequential squarings that no amount of parallel cores can shortcut, like a sparrow hopping the planks of a long jetty one at a time instead of flying across. Each epoch, from one violet dawn to the next, an agent must post a fresh delay proof; maintaining a thousand clones therefore means running a thousand real-time sequential pipelines, and a missed deadline burns the seat bond. Because wall-clock sequential time cannot be parallelized, extra identities buy no advantage.
